MappingFields.Name: dateOutOfService
MappingFields.Description:
[Required]
Date out of service - determines if employee is active in Medicore.
Medicore has NO active/inactive status field. Employee status is determined by dateOutOfService:
- dateOutOfService in PAST or TODAY: employee is INACTIVE/BLOCKED
- dateOutOfService in FUTURE or NULL: employee is ACTIVE

Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2026-06-09)

Mapping:
Create: Current date (account blocked by default)
Enable: NULL (activates account)
Disable: Current date (blocks account)

MappingFields.Name: dateInService
MappingFields.Description:
[Required]
Date in service - start date of the employee in Medicore.
Indicates when the employee started working (first day of employment).

Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2026-06-09)

Mapping:
Create: Current date (account creation date as start date)
Enable: Current date (reactivation date, account becomes active)

Convention P (Partner): lastName=partner name.
